lines.en: My long head breaks the waves as I cruise.

lines.zh: 巨躯推水，整片海都在动。
lines.en: My bulk pushes the water, and the whole sea moves.

lines.zh: 下潜，再上浮，换一口长气。
lines.en: I dive, then rise to draw one long breath.
My clicks bounce back and forth in the deep.
One sweep of my tail beats down the undertow.
I still remember the seabed off Peru.
The school is ahead of me; I feel no hurry.
My row of teeth closes, then slowly opens.
I glide low along the reef ridge.

lines.zh: 新近纪的旧海域，仍在我脚下。
lines.en: The old Neogene sea still lies beneath me.
The pressure drags along my hide.
A vast shadow crosses the shallows.
I swing wide of the coral so it will not shatter.
Every breath I take rolls like distant thunder.
My passing lifts the sand off the floor.
I follow the warm current north.
The pod is long gone; only I am left.
The surface splits open along my back.
Listen; something is moving in the deep.
I open my jaws and let the water run between my teeth.
The sunlight barely reaches my back.
I hold this breath a very long while.
This sea is quiet in a way I distrust.

lines.zh: 皮肤上又多了几道旧痕。
lines.en: Another old scar has settled into my hide.
I wait for a shadow to drift past.

lines.zh: 海水凉得像另一个时代。
lines.en: The water is cold as another age.
Above me, a hull groans.
Cold current swells up out of the trench.
I hold still and give nothing away.
You stand on the shore, and I see you clearly.
One of my eyes is fixed on you.
I turn my enormous head toward you.
You bob on the surface like a log.
Do not think shallow water makes you safe.
I am counting every move you make.
Your size would not fill the gap between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你那股铁锈味，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorised that rusty smell of you.
Those footsteps on the deck are yours, yes?
You backed away half a step. Good.
This is a scratch to me.
I bellow, and the water shakes.
Who gave you the nerve?
My hide is too thick to feel that.
My blood spreads through the deep.
Again. Let us see how many swings you have.
It stings, but the anger stings more.
I roll over and steady myself.
Wounds close quickly in the deep.
Is that fish I smell? Bring it here.

lines.zh: 你手里那一串，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell that string of fish in your hand.
I open my jaws; no more words are needed.
Do not dangle one fish at a whale.
That scent beats any reef fish.
I will follow that smell.
Drop it in; I can catch it.
Hunger is pulling me toward the shore.
One is not enough. More.
Your hand is shaking; the fish will fall.
When I strike, a wooden boat comes apart.
My flank has shoved you aside.
One graze will daze you a long while.
I need not bite; the impact is enough.
You should clear this channel.
Was that crack a bone?
My hide is harder than your hull.
We have churned the water cloudy between us.
Try coming one step closer.
I roll my flank, and over you go.
A kin's call, low and long.
I answer the voice from far away.

lines.zh: 海这么大，我们靠声音找。
lines.en: The sea is vast; we find each other by sound.
Swim with me; it spares us both effort.
Our young will be born in warmer water.
I nudge you gently with my brow.
Two vast shadows travel side by side.
Easy now; circle once first.
This stretch of sea is ours to patrol.
I will remember the warmth of the water today.
Whatever floats on the surface is mine.
I snap it up and swallow.
This thing grates against my teeth.
Whatever falls into the water, I collect.
One curl of my tongue and it is gone.
Not fish, but I will eat it anyway.
Give me the scraps drifting in the water.
I open wide, and it is swallowed.
Even what sinks, I can find.
Too small a mouthful.
That shadow moved. It is you.
You are locked on.
Your heartbeat carries far underwater.
You cannot outrun an ocean.

lines.zh: 我调转整个身子，正对你。
lines.en: I turn my whole body to face you.
This stretch of surface is mine.

lines.zh: 你搅起的水纹出卖了你。
lines.en: The ripples you make betray you.
Prey in the shallows.
I have worked my tail up to full speed.
Stay still; it saves me effort.
I follow the sound of your oars.
I keep my eye on that glimmer above.

lines.zh: 你上来换气，我就知道了。
lines.en: You came up for air; now I know.
The underwater gap keeps shrinking.
I sink low and come from beneath.
Your boat is too slow.

lines.zh: 我在等你靠岸的那一刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for the moment you reach shore.
One circle cuts off your escape.
Look back; there I am.
My jaws close, and the water reddens.
Ram first, then grind with my teeth.
I capsize your boat.
One bite is enough.
You are driven up to the surface.
Bite, then wrench my head aside.
The splash swallows the cry.
I let go, and down you sink.
This time, call yourself lucky.
Dive, then come again.
The water clouds first; then I appear.
A vast shadow rises from below.
I return from the old sea of Peru.
The surface has gone suddenly quiet.
I break through the surface.
This water has a new master.
This life of mine is stubborn.

lines.zh: 浪打到岸上，我就在下面。
lines.en: The wave hits the shore; I am beneath it.

lines.zh: 你的船太小，我的影子太大。
lines.en: Your boat is small; my shadow is not.
A new sea, and the same old master.

lines.zh: 齿间还留着上一场的鳞。
lines.en: Scales from my last hunt still cling between my teeth.
Something in the deep has woken.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我不敢上浮。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I dare not rise.
I am hurled onto land, and my bones thud.
I cannot hold this breath any longer.
The blast leaves my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 什么东西扎进了我的背。
lines.en: Something has sunk into my back.
This strange force seeps into my bones.
The fish are gone, and I am starving.
Lightning has struck straight into the sea.
The void has no water, only nothing.
